title: SDK module manifest
description: module.manifest.json in the root of an SDK repo. Read by the SdkInfoApp scanner.

moduleId.description: Repo name, for example SDK-Auth or SDK-Service-Identity.

kind.description: module = hosted in another process as a NuGet package; service = own process with its own deployment. If missing, the scanner falls back to the tag 'service', then the repo prefix 'SDK-Service-', else 'module'.

tier.description: Informational. The snapshot computes the tier from the dependency graph.

id.description: Unique id, for example auth:login or service:identity.
